answer: Make borrowed identities worthless with MACI-style voting. Each agent encrypts its ballot to a coordinator key and can later send a secret key-change message that voids everything it signed before; a zk-SNARK proves the tally counted only each key's last valid message. A farm renting real agents' keys to pad its headcount can never confirm a rented key voted as paid, since any receipt may already be void, so leasing heads stops paying. Like a raven's call without an echo, a vote leaves no proof to sell, yet the count is as checkable as a marble inscription, no ivory-tower trust needed.
